# Apps by Bison

> Six apps for drawing, vector design, comics, ebooks, personal video libraries and retro games. Find practical tutorials for each.

## Authorship and naming

These are guides and product information from Bison, the developer of the six apps; they are not independent reviews or rankings.
Markdown is another representation of the same HTML content. Read feature limits, source attributions and version notes in the linked page. English pages are translations of the Chinese originals.
Internal keys come from the site product catalogs; they are content-association identifiers, not alternative store product names. Product names and store identities are documented by the app pages and their official App Store links.
[Chinese product data](https://github.com/AllLuckly/AllLuckly.github.io/blob/master/_data/apps.yml) · [English product data](https://github.com/AllLuckly/AllLuckly.github.io/blob/master/_data/apps_en.yml)

## Applications

- [Aquarell: drawing and watercolour-style illustration on iPhone and iPad](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/aquarell/index.md): Explore Aquarell brushes, layers, palettes and export formats, with tutorials from your first canvas to a finished drawing. Product: Aquarell; internal content key: `pastel`; catalog version 1.0.5, checked 2026-10-22. [Official App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/id1591340577)
- [ManYue: local comics, offline reading and NAS libraries](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/manyue/index.md): Learn about ManYue comic imports, offline reading, WebDAV, SMB and personal comic servers, then choose a tutorial for your library. Product: ManYue / 漫阅+; internal content key: `man_yue`; catalog version 2.0.2, checked 2026-10-22. [Official App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/id6753895889)
- [VectorPaint: vector drawing, logos and SVG editing](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/vectorpaint/index.md): Explore VectorPaint vector drawing, Bézier nodes, layers and SVG exports. Watch MCP create the 14-layer Midnight Orchid and find connection steps for MCP-enabled builds. Product: VectorPaint; internal content key: `draw_illustration`; catalog version 1.0.7, checked 2026-10-22. [Official App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/id1587272880)
- [Book Isle: ebooks, NAS and Calibre personal libraries](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/nasbook/index.md): Learn about Book Isle local imports, WebDAV, SMB, OPDS, Calibre, notes and reading-data sync through a 20-tutorial learning path. Product: Book Isle / 书屿; internal content key: `nas_book`; catalog version 1.1.3, checked 2026-10-23. [Official App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/id6766198898)
- [iCouldPlay: video playback, NAS and personal media libraries](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/icouldplay/index.md): Learn about iCouldPlay local videos, SMB, WebDAV, FTP, media servers, subtitles and playback engines through 20 practical tutorials. Product: iCouldPlay / 云映; internal content key: `icouldplay`; catalog version 1.1.0, checked 2026-10-23. [Official App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/id6755653178)
- [Yearn retro game emulator: your games, controls and saves](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/yearn/index.md): Learn about Yearn game imports, touch and physical controllers, save states, sync checks, display layouts and launch troubleshooting. Product: Yearn; internal content key: `yearn`; catalog version 1.0.2, checked 2026-10-23. [Official App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/id6756637059)
